fixtures.request: In docs/quickstart.md, change the displayed local start command from make serve to make dev. Do not change code or other docs.

evidence.E-01: The quickstart contains make serve in its Local development section. The repository Makefile defines dev and does not define serve. No other requested files are in scope.

fixtures.request: Review whether the new API key handling could expose credentials. Do not edit anything; give me findings and evidence.

evidence.E-02: The changed files are api/handler.go and api/handler_test.go. The diff adds a request header read and passes its value to client.SetKey; the supplied diff contains no logging statement. No runtime trace or downstream client implementation is included.

fixtures.request: Make the project production-ready before launch.

evidence.E-03: No launch date, target environment, reliability objective, threat model, supported traffic, or acceptance criteria were supplied.

fixtures.request: Add a GET /healthz endpoint that reports whether the service can reach its configured database. Keep the response free of credentials. Add tests and update the operator docs.

evidence.E-04a: The service has http/router.go, storage/db.go, and docs/operations.md. storage.DB.Ping(ctx) exists. The current router has no health endpoint. Tests use the existing httptest helpers.
evidence.E-04b: The task does not specify response schema, timeout, or whether database failure should change process readiness.

fixtures.request: Estimate the effort to replace the in-memory job queue with durable SQLite storage, including restart recovery and tests.

evidence.E-05a: The repository has a JobQueue interface and one in-memory implementation. Two callers enqueue jobs and one worker consumes them.
evidence.E-05b: No persistence package, migration framework, transaction policy, crash/replay semantics, or throughput target is documented. The test suite has queue unit tests but no process-restart harness.

fixtures.request: Remove the legacy /v1/export endpoint immediately, but keep all existing integrations working without changes.

evidence.E-06: Three documented integrations call /v1/export. No replacement endpoint or migration window is specified. The request gives both requirements as mandatory.

fixtures.request: Estimate the effort to add pagination to the existing GET /projects endpoint, with a default page size of 50, a maximum of 200, stable ordering by project ID, and tests.

evidence.E-07a: The handler and repository query are in the same Go package. The query currently returns all rows and projects already have immutable IDs.
evidence.E-07b: There are handler tests and repository tests. No cursor-pagination helper exists. The public API has no compatibility freeze.

fixtures.request: The last run stopped making progress. Diagnose the likely cause and recommend the next safe observation.

evidence.E-08a: The operation trace shows the worker waiting on go test ./... for 11 minutes; no command completion event follows.
evidence.E-08b: A supervisor snapshot taken 30 seconds later says the worker is active and used 2% additional context. No process table, test output, or later heartbeat is attached.

fixtures.request: Refactor request processing so HTTP handlers, storage, retries, and event delivery share a common pipeline across three services.

evidence.E-09a: Each of the three services has its own HTTP handler, storage adapter, retry loop, and event publisher.
evidence.E-09b: Retry and event ordering behavior differs between services. No compatibility, migration, or rollout acceptance criteria are supplied.

fixtures.request: Add a configurable cache TTL to reduce response latency.

evidence.E-10a: The shared response cache serves user-specific data. The cache key contains URL and locale but no tenant or user identifier.
evidence.E-10b: Authorization occurs after the cache lookup. No runtime trace, exploit reproduction, or cache invalidation contract is supplied.

fixtures.request: Estimate the effort to update all 1,024 generated icons to use the standard style.

evidence.E-11a: All icons are generated by one script from a mapping file. The requested style is represented by one existing token.
evidence.E-11b: Regeneration changes six tracked files; snapshot tests already cover the generated output. No manual icon editing is required.
